scan.pinterest_status: Pinterest's Newsroom, Business Palette reporting, public Design guides, Creator trends, Fall Hobbies report, November content calendar and linked public inspiration were checked on 6 November 2026. No newer featured Newsroom item appeared after the 26 October Programmatic Deals announcement. The creator page continues Opera-inspired accessories, Whimsy Party, Skirt Season and Suede Styling; the Fall report continues tactile, screen-free hobbies. Palette guidance emphasizes exact named hues, monochrome walls, colour-forward UGC, seasonal detail swaps and discovery tools. Gen Z typography guidance emphasizes chunky all-caps, selective 3D depth, sticker phrases, repetition and one controlled rule-break. These are already represented by the live palette, emotional-palette, typography, type-led, zine, brand, fashion, social and campaign systems. Four linked public inspiration pages again returned HTTP 403, so no unsupported visual conclusion was derived from them.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.28.0 with 723 commands, 42 categories and 40 bundles was read from GitHub main and compared with Drive before evaluation. /palette and /emotional-palette already define colour roles, contrast, material response and channel use; /taste-discovery-system and /trend-to-brand cover personalised colour discovery and brand translation. /typeled, /typography, /zine-editorial-system, /retro-pop-branding, /layout and social/poster systems already cover expressive display type, dimensional treatments, sticker-like accents, repetition, rhythm and controlled imperfection while preserving legibility. /theatrical-opulence, fashion/wardrobe systems and campaign bundles cover the monthly style signals. Separate Palette, Gen Z font or seasonal trend aliases would be redundant and short-lived, so the userscript and metadata remained byte-identical. All 22 regression checks passed.

Opera-inspired accessories and Whimsy Party continue theatrical luxury and visibly handmade celebration signals
Skirt Season and Suede Styling remain seasonal wardrobe and material signals rather than reusable production methods
